change: Replaced the flat 2 point fabrication-rate improvement threshold in decide() with a case level paired cluster bootstrap rule: a benefit counts as confirmed only if its bootstrap confidence interval excludes zero at 90 percent confidence, a cost counts as confirmed only under the same test, a change is accepted if its benefit is confirmed and it has no confirmed cost, and if both are confirmed the benefit lower bound must exceed the cost upper bound. The original threshold was a round number chosen before any experiment ran. A power calculation against this sample size showed it sat roughly an order of magnitude below the minimum detectable effect, so it could not reliably have told a real improvement from noise.
